features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: At 3rd level, you gain proficiency in Stealth. If already proficient, gain proficiency in another barbarian class skill of your choice.

features.name: Mistwood Defender
features.description:
Starting at 3rd level, you can use Reckless Attack on ranged weapon attacks with thrown weapons. While not within melee range of a non-incapacitated hostile creature, you can draw and throw a weapon as a bonus action.

When making a STR-based ranged attack with a thrown weapon while raging, add your Rage Damage bonus to the damage.

features.name: From the Mist
features.description:
Beginning at 6th level, mist and fog don't hinder your vision. You can cast *misty step* and make one attack with a thrown weapon immediately before or after as part of the same bonus action. You can cast this while raging.

Uses equal to proficiency bonus; regain all on long rest.

features.name: Mist Dance
features.description:
Starting at 10th level, when you use the Attack action while raging, you can replace one of your attacks to make one attack against each creature within 5 feet of you.

Uses equal to proficiency bonus; regain all on long rest.

features.name: War Band's Passage
features.description: Starting at 14th level, when you use From the Mist to cast *misty step*, you can bring up to two willing creatures within 5 feet (not over carrying capacity) along with you. Attacks against you and any creatures you bring have disadvantage until the start of your next turn.
